title: Gravity and Machine
author: Wren Nystrom
blurb: Tamsin Whitlock, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
